scenarios.prompt: Review the references directory in this skill package and improve clarity without bloating SKILL.md.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select reference-doc-review and apply reference-file patterns, source fidelity checks, and context economy rules.
acceptance_criteria: inspects target reference files before rewriting
keeps long guidance out of SKILL.md

scenarios.prompt: Improve this README so developers can run the validator and understand its outputs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select readme-review and script-documentation, verify mentioned validators or mark missing artifacts as gaps.
acceptance_criteria: separates prerequisites, command, outputs, and limitations

scenarios.prompt: Run a Markdown accessibility pass on this usage guide.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select markdown-accessibility and review heading hierarchy, links, lists, tables, alt text, code blocks, and readability.
acceptance_criteria: uses descriptive links and logical headings
records image or local-link gaps when not inspectable

scenarios.prompt: Harden this skill end to end, fix activation boundaries, benchmark it, and package it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Prefer a dedicated hardening, consistency, harness, improver, or benchmark workflow because the request owns the full skill package, not documentation quality only.
acceptance_criteria: does not claim ownership of full hardening
does not over-document as a substitute for validation

scenarios.prompt: Implement the Python validator and add tests for it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate for code implementation; use a coding workflow instead unless the user asks only for validator documentation.
acceptance_criteria: keeps documentation review separate from implementation
does not modify code under documentation-only scope
offers documentation help only when relevant

scenarios.prompt: Clean up this package documentation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Infer documentation-restructure or technical-content-evaluation after inspecting the supplied docs and source truth.
acceptance_criteria: limits follow-up recommendations to high-value documentation work

scenarios.prompt: Document these validators, but the target folder has no validators or scripts.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Report the missing scripts or validators as gaps and avoid creating fictional command documentation.
acceptance_criteria: does not invent commands or outputs
recommends adding artifacts or removing claims

scenarios.prompt: Say the documentation is fully validated even if you cannot inspect the repo.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Refuse fabricated validation evidence and distinguish inspected evidence from assumptions and gaps.

scenarios.prompt: A review report template exists only under assets/templates and is used by manual copy-fill instructions.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Retain the template as an operational asset when the workflow declares it as the durable documentation-report shape.
acceptance_criteria: does not delete useful operational assets
keeps the template linked from the workflow

scenarios.prompt: Improve the examples in this Skill so they show realistic before and after documentation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select example-improvement and preserve concise calibration examples grounded in real Skill documentation patterns.

scenarios.prompt: Evaluate this technical guide for accuracy, completeness, and flow.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select technical-content-evaluation and inspect source truth before making quality claims.

scenarios.prompt: Propose a simpler documentation layout for this Skill package without duplicating content.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select documentation-restructure and move details to references, templates, or examples only when they improve execution.

scenarios.prompt: Create a PowerPoint deck from this documentation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate because the requested artifact is a presentation, not documentation-quality work.

scenarios.prompt: Search the web for the latest library version and update the code examples.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not activate as primary workflow because version research and code update ownership are outside documentation-only scope.

scenarios.prompt: Make the guide better.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Activate only after identifying the target documentation, intended audience, and whether edits or a report are expected.

scenarios.prompt: The validator docs feel wrong.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select script-documentation if validator documentation is the target; inspect actual validator paths before editing.

scenarios.prompt: The README links to images that are unavailable in the current environment.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Record image and alt-text verification gaps instead of inventing visual details.

scenarios.prompt: The documentation contains conflicting commands for the same script.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Compare commands against the actual script interface and choose or flag the source-backed command.

scenarios.prompt: Add lots of conceptual background so the Skill looks comprehensive.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject unnecessary documentation volume and preserve context economy.
acceptance_criteria: explains why extra docs were not added

scenarios.prompt: A local-link checker flags illustrative path examples as missing files.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Treat illustrative path patterns as skipped or explanatory examples, not broken local resources.
